scope: Add generated negative row custom-data item count controls to the existing AC1024 inline TABLECONTENT parser vector.

method.kind: In-memory generated parser-vector extension using the existing test target
validation: git diff --check for touched test, plan, and receipt

controls.expected: Reject before iteration because the under-limit count's minimum item width cannot fit the remaining bounded body.
Reject the count above the configured maximum.

assertions: The generated frame successfully reaches the row custom-data count after one valid cell/value profile.
The entity prefix remains readable and the input buffer remains good.
Semantic TABLECONTENT is marked incomplete; no partial columns or rows are published.
The committed input cursor remains at TABLECONTENT start.
limitations: The vectors are source-authored parser profiles, not producer-qualified AC1024 samples.
Cell attributes, linked-data framing, other custom-data locations, and full-file dispatch were not tested.
No full suite, peer, or native application was run.
